# Sentzunhat Corp.

Sentzunhat Corp. is an independent, founder-led software company based in Winnipeg, Manitoba. It builds focused products and reusable engineering foundations with an emphasis on understandable systems, portable data, privacy-conscious architecture, and human control.

## Project pages

- [Mochilada](https://sentzunhat.com/projects/mochilada/) — current commercial focus; local-first social archive preservation and organization; preparing for a macOS-first release.
- [HAWP](https://sentzunhat.com/projects/hawp/) — published open-source Human-AI Workflow Protocol.
- [Zacatl](https://sentzunhat.com/projects/zacatl/) — published open-source TypeScript service framework.
- [Tekit](https://sentzunhat.com/projects/tekit/) — prototype exploring clearer ways to find and understand files across cloud providers.
- [Chiwakal](https://sentzunhat.com/projects/chiwakal/) — active local-first notes and knowledge workspace prototype.
- [Noyolo](https://sentzunhat.com/projects/noyolo/) — validation-stage transportation-planning research focused on overlapping mobility disruptions.
